statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
There is concern for a potential transient cerebral ischemic attack
The patient has a personal history of TIA and cerebral infarction
A 48-hour Holter monitoring study (CPT 93226) is ordered
The service is supported by diagnoses G45.9, R42, and Z86.73
The continuous cardiac monitoring is clinically indicated to correlate reported symptoms with intermittent arrhythmic activity
The claim was denied under reason code CO-22
The denial reason is that care may be covered by another payer in accordance with coordination of benefits protocols
Prairie State Medicaid has determined that primary coverage is applicable and must be exhausted first
